goal: The security officer should see, in order, what is waiting on which seat, what the Watch has recorded on the same objects, and what changed since the last look; nothing else.

candidates.name: Trigger-led, seat by seat
candidates.rationale: Page policy leads Spend Requests with trigger; the officer's first priority is decisions pending.

candidates.name: Interpret-led
candidates.rationale: Interpretation on a queue page delays the one thing the reader came for.

manifest.assumption: Reader is the security officer; decisions pending come first
Page is not aggregate-only; individual items are shown
